approved_mapping.limit: No added thin mullions, fine grid or gray paint extending onto the unobserved other short end. Existing irregular lower bays retained, not reinterpreted from adjacent long building.

approved_mapping.family: dark gray / subdued blue-gray reflected shade
approved_mapping.limit: Discrete original backs only, not a continuous blue wall; photograph lighting does not establish literal glass tint.

approved_mapping.region: Top frame front face x approximately -45..45, z130..143
approved_mapping.limit: 3827 shows full front outline and its openings. Original simplified two slots are not exact photograph geometry. Horizontal top and unobserved rear face stay neutral; no new intermediate posts.
1948 supports this one end only. Existing small recesses may receive generic dark shade; no invented cantilever shades, texture or brick coursing.

coordinate_mapping.front: y=-53, x from left to right in straight-on frontage view
coordinate_mapping.reason: 1948 shows the sparse single-column short end at image left and the gray-grid frontage receding to image right, matching the original front-preview left-front viewpoint. Original x=-46 has narrow single-column side recesses; x=+46 has wider recesses and is not the photographed end.
coordinate_mapping.geographic_direction: Not independently established; do not label cardinal orientation from these photographs alone.

unknown_neutral_regions: Opposite x=+46 short-end outer face, despite brick margins visible in frontal photograph; margins alone do not certify entire side.
Rear y=+53 and broad horizontal roof.
Obscured lower entrance canopy, round landing, external stair and small post; do not borrow forecourt bridge, ramp or neighboring long-building details.
Display base and any uncertain interfaces.
mandatory_public_limits: B006 high block only, excludes physics/chemistry long wing, connecting bridge and large forecourt ramp.
Material families are approximate; 3827 dusk illumination is not calibrated paint color.
2018/2026 upload dates are not verified capture dates or a common-date architectural survey.
Original 2452 faces retained; color does not certify original dimensions/window counts/geometry.
Original photos private, no textures/public originals; retain source attribution/noncommercial terms and no commercial-rights guarantee.
No physical print or multi-filament slicing verification implied.
required_QA: Exact original STL bytes and mesh coordinate/triangle equality.
Actually inspect final front/end/back/roof views and details for fake diagonal patches.
Unknown side/roof/entry neutrality and material usage verification.
private_source_backup: Source photos and reviews are privately retained; not bundled in public deliverables.
source_backup: Original sources privately backed up in project backup folder; public package contains links and hashes only.
current_model_QA: See COLOR-FORMAT-GEOMETRY-QA.json, SCENE-QA.json, DELIVERY-QA.json and INDEPENDENT-COLOR-VISUAL-QA.json; source-issued pending flag is historical, not the final model status.
